candidates.name: Cable Silverback Shrug
candidates.cardText:
Cable Silverback Shrug
Novice
1
Use a bar attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the bottom.
2
Stand up with the attachment in hand, walk a couple of steps back make sure you are standing upright and not leaning backwards.
3
Retract your shoulder blades and then protract to return to the starting position.

candidates.name: Cable Row Bar Standing Row
candidates.cardText:
Cable Row Bar Standing Row
Novice
1
Place the cable at shoulder height. Use a row bar.
2
Pull the handles back using your arms. Push out your chest.
3
Pull the handles towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.

candidates.name: Cable Single Arm Underhand Grip Row
candidates.cardText:
Cable Single Arm Underhand Grip Row
Novice
1
Place the cable at shoulder height. Use a handle attachment. Face your palm upward.
2
Pull the handle back using your arms. Push out your chest.
3
Pull the handle towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.

candidates.name: Cable Single Arm Neutral Grip Row
candidates.cardText:
Cable Single Arm Neutral Grip Row
Novice
1
Place the cable at shoulder height. Use a handle attachment. Face your palm toward the midline of your body.
2
Pull the handle back using your arms. Push out your chest.
3
Pull the handle towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.

candidates.name: Cable Single Arm Rear Delt Row
candidates.cardText:
Cable Single Arm Rear Delt Row
Advanced
1
Use a handle attachment, grab with an overhand grip and take a position with the cable crossing your body.
2
Pull your elbows back while flaring your elbows outward.

candidates.name: Cable Pull Around
candidates.cardText:
Cable Pull Around
Novice
1
Place cable pin all the way at the top or nearly at the top of the cable stack.
2
Face sideways and take a half kneeling position.
3
Grab the handle and reach across the body, begin the pull.
4
As you pull, imagine you are trying to put your elbow into your pocket.

candidates.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Cross Rear Delt Row
candidates.cardText:
Cable Standing Single Arm Cross Rear Delt Row
Beginner
1
Stand sideways to cable and hold handle across your body at opposite side.
2
Pull handle outward and back, leading with elbow and keeping arm slightly bent.
3
Squeeze rear delt at the end, then return slowly with control.
